observations: Current operator resumes droppedL2 by sending raw bytes and L1 recordedTransaction always broadcasts; same-hash reuse is still retransmission.
Existing atomic0600 fileState poisoning is reusable; default recordedTransaction semantics for unrelated callers must not silently change.

Current operator initializes wallet before saved L2 operation handling, and claim-fees derives a dynamic operation name; reconcile dispatch must precede signing/proving/wallet/claim-secret reads for any retained intent.

Preparing without hash and uncertain persistence never justify another prepare/sign/send. Persist possibly-sent before first invocation. Canonical missing/dropped/reorg observations retain journal and public pending/failed status without replay.
Canonical successful constructor result needs exact receipt/effect/block and original/current class/deployer/four-argument identity; cached address alone is not acceptance.

Private transport key belongs outside config/identity/journal/output. Exact scoped URL/method/header, redirect rejection/no retry, bounded response, sanitized outward failure are required. Current top-level raw error.message/shortMessage logging needs attention at this boundary.

Native devnet/PXE flags false must avoid eager native prover preparation. Existing escrow adapter checkNetwork explicitly requiresproverEnabled true and customproofCreator mode: reuse policy patterns only, not this check unchanged.
Rolling constructor-only profile must reject old portal/register/earnings commands before sensitive/native initialization; full hosted Bok lifecycle remains separate.
